# Building Thermal Fleet (BuildingFleetAdapter)

> **Class**: `energysim.container.BuildingFleetAdapter` | add to a world with `add_fleet(fleet_type='building', ...)` (accepted kinds: `building`, `building_fleet`, `house`)

## Overview

Vectorized lumped thermal building envelope fleet (1R1C equivalent model).

Simulates N residential buildings simultaneously (explicit Euler):
  dT_in/dt = (T_ambient - T_in) / (R * C) + (Q_heat + Q_solar) / C

Explicit Euler is accurate/stable only for ``step_size << R*C`` (default 15 min vs 37.5 h).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'building_fleet'` | - | Container (simulator) name. |
| `size` | `int` | `100` | - | Number of entities N in the fleet. |
| `c_th_kwh_per_k` | `Union[float, np.ndarray]` | `15.0` | kWh/K | Thermal capacitance of the building (scalar or length-N array). |
| `r_th_k_per_kw` | `Union[float, np.ndarray]` | `2.5` | K/kW | Thermal resistance of the envelope (scalar or length-N array). |
| `initial_t_indoor` | `Union[float, np.ndarray]` | `20.0` | degC | Initial indoor temperature. |
| `step_size` | `float` | `900.0` | s | Micro time-step. |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `t_ambient` | unspecified | `t_amb`, `t_amb_degc`, `t_ambient_degc` |
| `q_heat_kw` | kW | `p_heat`, `p_heat_kw`, `q_heat` |
| `q_solar_kw` | kW | `q_solar`, `p_solar_kw` |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `t_indoor` | unspecified | `t_in`, `t_in_degc`, `t_indoor_degc` |

Every output `<var>` is also available as `total_<var>`, `mean_<var>`, `min_<var>`, `max_<var>` and per entity as `<var>[i]`. Units that read `unspecified` are not declared by the container; connections to or from them are never rescaled (see [Units](../units.md)).

## Validation

The fleet is tested against an explicit loop of scalar models (`tests/strengths/test_vectorized_fleets.py`); see [Validation](../validation.md).

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900, power_unit='kW')
sim.add_fleet(fleet_type='building', name='homes', size=500, step_size=900, power_unit='kW')
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['homes.mean_t_indoor'])
```
